description: HemoTrack is a multidisciplinary team developing a space-focused health monitoring concept to track hemolysis and red blood cell health in astronauts. Our project explores non-invasive breath carbon monoxide monitoring, personalized baselines, trend analysis, and early alerts. We are interested in biology, biomedical science, data analysis, software development, and user-centered design. We welcome creative collaborators who want to contribute to space health innovation.
